slot.brief: Direct scalar triple product of three given simple vectors; ask the numeric value or whether they are coplanar.

stem: For $\vec a=\hat i+\hat j$, $\vec b=\hat j+\hat k$ and $\vec c=\hat i+\hat k$, find $[\vec a,\vec b,\vec c]$.

verdicts.working: The scalar triple product is the determinant of the component matrix: [a,b,c] = det[[1,1,0],[0,1,1],[1,0,1]] = 2.

working:
$[\vec a,\vec b,\vec c]=\vec a\cdot(\vec b\times\vec c)$\\
$(\hat j+\hat k)\times(\hat i+\hat k)=\hat i+\hat j-\hat k$\\
$(\hat i+\hat j)\cdot(\hat i+\hat j-\hat k)=2$

Independent check: The scalar triple product is the determinant of the component matrix: [a,b,c] = det[[1,1,0],[0,1,1],[1,0,1]] = 2.
solution:
The scalar triple product is $[\vec a,\vec b,\vec c]=\vec a\cdot(\vec b\times\vec c)$.
$$\vec b\times\vec c=(\hat j+\hat k)\times(\hat i+\hat k)=\hat i+\hat j-\hat k$$
Thus $[\vec a,\vec b,\vec c]=(\hat i+\hat j)\cdot(\hat i+\hat j-\hat k)=2$.
